name: Raspberry Pi 3 Model B+

outline.source: Raspberry Pi 3 Model B+ mechanical drawing (Raspberry Pi Ltd)

pcb.source: typical 4-layer FR4 board thickness; not dimensioned on the mechanical drawing

mounting_holes.source: Raspberry Pi 3 Model B+ mechanical drawing (Raspberry Pi Ltd): 3.5 mm from the edges, 58 x 49 mm pattern, hole 2.75 and pad 6 as drawn

connectors.name: micro-USB power input
connectors.source: port centre x = 10.6 mm as drawn; body size from the receptacle datasheet
connectors.note: centre taken from the drawing, body size is a typical micro-B receptacle; verify before promoting to datasheet

connectors.name: HDMI (type A)
connectors.source: port centre x = 32.0 mm and Z-height 6.5 as drawn; shell about 15 mm wide
connectors.note: centre and height from the drawing, depth and overhang approximate

connectors.name: 3.5 mm audio / composite jack
connectors.source: jack centre x = 53.5 mm and Z-height 6.0 as drawn; housing about 7 mm wide

connectors.name: Ethernet (RJ45)
connectors.source: RJ45 jack centre y = 10.25 mm and Z-height 13.5 as drawn (the Pi 3 has Ethernet at the BOTTOM of the connector end); about 16 mm wide
connectors.note: centre and height from the drawing, width and overhang approximate

connectors.name: USB 2.0 stacked pair (lower)
connectors.source: double USB-A stack centre y = 29.0 mm and Z-height 16.0 as drawn; about 13.1 mm wide

connectors.name: USB 2.0 stacked pair (upper)
connectors.source: double USB-A stack centre y = 47.0 mm and Z-height 16.0 as drawn; about 13.1 mm wide

connectors.name: microSD card slot (underside)
connectors.source: socket on the underside of the board centred on the short edge; inserted card protrudes about 2.5 mm
connectors.note: card slot width and protrusion are approximate

connectors.name: 40-pin GPIO header
connectors.source: 2 x 20 header, 2.54 mm pitch, centred on y = 52.5 mm; Z-height 8.5 mm as drawn
connectors.note: no wall opening; the lid must clear it (keepout only)

omitted: CSI and DSI ribbon connectors (internal, no wall opening)
